svg.title: Automated versus reference phenotype counts
svg.desc: All identity-matched variant-paper rows are scored. Missing automated counts are evaluated as zero. Agreement plots use a square-root count scale.
svg.metadata: Analysis run: 20260905_mechanism4_final Locked at: 2026-09-05T18:40:29.976424+00:00 Evaluation rule: matched missing automated count is scored as zero Storage rule: missing automated count remains NULL in source data Identity misses are excluded from the plotted/scored rows Rows present in both count facets: 55 Marker radius is 8 + 2*sqrt(pair count), capped at 28 viewBox units Marker-size key values: 5, 10, and 25 variant-paper pairs
